{{Quote|How long can it take to get departure clearance from this lousy spaceport? Stupid locals.|[[Gault Rennow]]|<ref name="TOR:TtS" />}}
The '''Mos Ila spaceport''' was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Ila]], controlled by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] was restored by the [[Jawa Council]], but the [[Exchange]] took over the city, after which the Empire took the city from the Exchange.
